title: Ronan Shows Up and Turns a Massacre Into a Retreat
description: The line is breaking, the Kree are dying in droves, and the one man who can stop it is a wanted mass murderer.
hook_note: Picks up exactly at the collapsing flank, then drops in a fugitive war criminal as the only hope.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: That right flank Quill was screaming about? Two Kree battalions, and it just broke.

segments.text: That right flank Quill was screaming about?
Two Kree battalions, and it just broke.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: "We're breached!" they yell. "Too many!" And they're not wrong.

segments.text: "We're breached! " they yell.
"Too many! " And they're not wrong.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Here's the mad part. The Kree live for war. And they've forgotten how to fight it.

segments.text: Here's the mad part.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Ever since House Fiyero grabbed Hala, their whole plan is: throw bodies.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Casualties: staggering. But this time, Rich says, they got lucky.

shots.line: Because Ronan was on-site. Used to be Ronan the Accuser. Judge, jury, executioner.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Now? He's a fugitive from the exact same Kree justice he used to hand out.

shots.line: So naturally a Kree commander screams he carries no authority here.

shots.line: His reasoning? He doesn't think Ronan is even capable of lying.

shots.line: "Fall back! Remember you are Kree!" he orders. And somehow they hold.
